title: Urine volatile organic compounds in predicting chronic obstructive pulmonary disease risk in a national observational study
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, 27,2588-2600
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00181A, Paper
Shuojia Xie, Junfeng Huang, Gengjia Chen, Huiting Luo, Yuexi Chen, Xiaowen Zhong, Linhang Yang, Ziwen Zheng, Zhaowei Yang, Shiyue Li, Linwei Tian, Ruchong Chen
Urine volatile organic compounds (VOCs) are associated with increased COPD risk, with inflammatory factors playing an important role in this relationship. Urine VOCs show potential for COPD risk prediction, but further studies are needed.
